d:
Bihar ke begusray men disielaaar bakhri ke nam ka bord lagi skorpiyo se sharab taskari ka khulasa huaa hai. pulis ne panhas chauk ke pas gari ki talashi li to usmen videshi sharab ke 25 kartun mile. chalak samet tin logon ko giraphtar kiya gaya hai. bataya ja raha hai ki praivet nanbar ki yah skorpiyo disielaaar bakhri ke yahan kiraye par chalti hai. ab pulis pure mamle ki janch kar rahi hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
